name: Fort Worth Zoo

research_notes: [2026-08-23] Official-source Wave 2a public list pass (habitats + Predators + construction updates).

do_not_list.name: African elephant
do_not_list.reason: Official: Asian elephants at Elephant Springs.

do_not_list.name: African penguin
do_not_list.reason: Official: African penguins moved to Waco; remaining penguins are southern rockhopper.

do_not_list.name: Galápagos tortoise
do_not_list.reason: Official herpetarium / chats list Aldabra tortoise, not Galápagos.

do_not_list.name: Asian small-clawed otter
do_not_list.reason: Official: North American river otter, not Asian small-clawed.

do_not_list.name: Chimpanzee
do_not_list.reason: Official World of Primates lists bonobos, not chimpanzees.

bonus_hunt.tagline: Fort Worth bonus · Predators + Savanna + Primates

challenges.text: Predators: watch a lion for 20 seconds — roar, rest, or pace?
Tiger yard: count stripe clusters on one shoulder (best guess).
Hippo river: more underwater, mud, or bank?
World of Primates sloth: mid-reach or statue-still?
